name: silvershop-suite/cookieconsent
description: A first-class, self-hosted consent-management platform (CMP) for SilverStripe: an accessible cookie banner + in-banner preferences centre, a server + JS consent-state API ($HasConsent), true script/tag blocking, Google Consent Mode v2 signalling and an immutable consent log. Works on any SilverStripe 6 site - no shop dependency.

suggest.tractorcow/silverstripe-fluent: Localises the banner copy and the cookie declaration (categories + cookies).
suggest.symbiote/silverstripe-gridfieldextension: Adds drag-and-drop ordering to the cookie declaration in the CMS.
suggest.symbiote/silverstripe-queuedjobs: Schedules the immutable consent-log retention prune as a recurring job.
suggest.silvershop-suite/analytics: Consent bridge - statistics consent flips the analytics session flag with zero coupling.
